# Spinner

A `Spinner` is the default element for loading patterns.
See [Loading guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/spinner/design)

## API

<Source code="import { Spinner } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Property "showPercentage" works only when "size" is set to "medium".
- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root element
- For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/Spinner/index.ts)

## Examples

### Variants

<Canvas of={SpinnerStories.Variants} />

### Indeterminate

Without a percentage value, the component will display a looping animation.
You can switch from indeterminate to determinate by setting the percentage value when the loading process becomes measurable.

<Canvas of={SpinnerStories.Intermediate} />

### Dots

Use the dot loading version for targeted and/or simultaneous loading, in a chat for example.

<Canvas of={SpinnerStories.Dots} />
